title: Chicken Shop Date host says she ended YouTube show … to find a real date
summary_full: Amelia Dimoldenberg described two panic attacks and said she wanted to end the hit series ‘before I start resenting it’Amelia Dimoldenberg, the host of Chicken Shop Date, has said she decided to end the popular YouTube series which had increasingly left her feeling “isolated” and made her search for real relationships more challenging.The comedian, 32, also revealed she had questioned the future of the interview series after suffering two panic attacks, saying she wanted to end it “before I start resenting it”.
